about: Licences a package shipped inside the app may have. All are permissive and allow redistribution. Adding a licence here needs the owner's approval; see .claude/rules/dependencies.md. Checked by scripts/check-licenses.mjs.

fonts.about: The owner has approved the SIL Open Font License for bundled fonts, and for nothing else. It is accepted only for the packages named here; code under it is refused. Each font's LICENSE file must ship with the app.

shippedDevDependencies.about: Listed under devDependencies because a packaged app must not also install them, but shipped all the same.
